in_sanskrit.name: Gemine
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon Gem
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gemine एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from 'Gem' and 'Moon', symbolizing the one who is as beautiful and precious as the moon and gems.

in_hindi.name: Gemine
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon Gem
in_hindi.long_meaning: Gemine एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from 'Gem' and 'Moon', symbolizing the one who is as beautiful and precious as the moon and gems.

in_tamil.name: Gemine
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Moon Gem
in_tamil.long_meaning: Gemine ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। A name derived from 'Gem' and 'Moon', symbolizing the one who is as beautiful and precious as the moon and gems.

in_telugu.name: Gemine
in_telugu.long_meaning: Gemine ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। A name derived from 'Gem' and 'Moon', symbolizing the one who is as beautiful and precious as the moon and gems.

in_marathi.name: Gemine
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gemine हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from 'Gem' and 'Moon', symbolizing the one who is as beautiful and precious as the moon and gems.

in_bengali.name: Gemine
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon Gem
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gemine একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from 'Gem' and 'Moon', symbolizing the one who is as beautiful and precious as the moon and gems.
